limitations: Synthetic cases and simulated dispatcher approvals; not production traffic.
Held-out cases are small parameter variants, not a broad generalization benchmark.
Protocol-only cases skipped in live grading; excluded from denominators.

No source, prompt or model configuration changed between development and held-out.

OpenRouter inference usage excludes credit-purchase fee and coding-assistant usage.
